features: 111W High Power Output – The Portronics Car Power Quard delivers a massive 111W total output, ensuring fast and efficient charging for all connected devices while on the road.

4 Ports for Simultaneous Charging – Equipped with four high-speed ports, this car charger allows you to charge up to four devices at the same time, making it ideal for families, carpools, and long trips.
Dual 33W Type-C PD Ports – Features two 33W Power Delivery ports that provide ultra-fast charging for smartphones, tablets, iPhones, iPads, and other Type-C enabled devices.
Dual 22.5W USB-A Ports – Includes two 22.5W USB-A ports designed for quick charging of Android phones, earbuds, smartwatches, dash cams, and other compatible gadgets.
Universal Compatibility – Works seamlessly with a wide range of devices including iPhones, Samsung, OnePlus, Xiaomi, Pixel, tablets, Bluetooth headphones, power banks, cameras, and more.
Safety Assured – Built with an advanced multi-protection chipset that safeguards against overheating, overcharging, over-voltage, and short circuits to keep your devices safe.
Durable and Sleek Design – Designed with a compact and sturdy build that blends well with modern car interiors while offering long-lasting durability for everyday use.
Ideal Travel Companion – Lightweight and easy to carry, this car charger is perfect for daily commutes, business trips, or long drives, ensuring uninterrupted power for all your essential devices.
description: The Car Power Quard is your all-in-one car charging solution, designed to keep every device powered on the go. With a total output of 111W, it features dual 33W Type-C PD ports and dual 22.5W USB-A ports to charge up to four devices at once. Whether it’s smartphones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches, dash cams, or power banks, this car charger ensures efficient and reliable performance every time. Supporting PD 3.0 and QC 3.0 protocols, it can power up devices to 50% in just 30 minutes. Its sleek, fire-resistant build comes with multiple safety protections against overcharge, overheating, and short circuits, making it durable and safe for everyday travel. Compact in design, it blends seamlessly into any car interior while delivering maximum convenience.
